introduction:
Obtaining or digitizing a Death Certificate in Rajasthan is managed through the Pehchan Portal (pehchan.raj.nic.in). This process is designed to help citizens digitize old (legacy) offline death certificates online without initially requiring a Jan Aadhaar card or Family ID.

The digitization process requires the old offline Registration Number and Year of Registration, which must be verified by local registrars before submitting the application online for final digital certificate issuance.
quickFacts:
Quick Facts & Key Details
  • State: Rajasthan
  • Portal Used: Pehchan Portal (pehchan.raj.nic.in)
  • Purpose: Digitize and obtain an old (legacy) death certificate online without requiring a Jan Aadhaar card/Family ID.
  • Key Requirement: Must possess the old offline Registration Number and Year of Registration from local authorities.
  • Authentication: Requires Aadhaar card of the applicant (relative) and Aadhaar-linked OTP verification.
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: Ensure you have the old registration proof from the local registrar's manual logs before starting the online computerization.
Applicant & Deceased Details
  • Applicant's Aadhaar Card: Required for OTP verification (must be a relative: Husband/Wife, Father, or Mother).
  • Aadhaar-linked Mobile Number: Active mobile to receive verification OTPs.
  • Deceased's Information: Accurate name, age, date of death, father's name, and permanent address (in both Hindi and English).
Legacy Proof & Image Specs
  • Proof of Old Registration: A written document or receipt (on official letterpad) from the local Registrar/Gram Sevak containing the old Registration Number and Registration Year.
  • Scanned Image: JPG scan of the offline registration proof/letterpad (File size: 50 KB to 100 KB).
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Step-by-Step Online Legacy Computerization Process

Step 1: The Offline Visit (Prerequisite)

Before applying online, visit your local Atal Seva Kendra, Gram Panchayat, or Nagar Palika office. Ask the Secretary, Gram Sevak, or VDO to search their manual records for the death entry. If found, have them write down the Registration Number and Registration Year on their official letterpad. If the death was never registered, you must follow the complete offline process first (see Method 2).

Step 2: The Online Process
  1. Go to the official Pehchan portal (pehchan.raj.nic.in).
  2. Scroll down to the "सेवाएं" (Services) section.
  3. Crucial Step: Do NOT click "आमजन - आवेदन प्रपत्र भरे" (Citizen - Fill Application Form) as this requires a Jan Aadhaar card. Instead, click on the "आवेदन - लिगेसी प्रमाण पत्र कम्प्यूटरीकरण" (Application - Legacy Certificate Computerization) box.
  4. Select "मृत्यु प्रपत्र के लिए" (For Death Certificate) and click "प्रवेश करे" (Enter).
  5. Aadhaar Verification: Select the applicant's relationship to the deceased. Enter the applicant's Aadhaar number and captcha, click "ओ.टी.पी. प्राप्त करे" (Get OTP), and verify with the code received.
  6. Registration Details: Enter the manual Registration Number and Year. Select location type (Rural/Urban), State, District, and your specific local Registrar's Office.
  7. Deceased Details: Fill in the date of death, gender, name (in Hindi and English), age, and father's name. Red asterisk (*) fields are mandatory.
  8. Address & Place of Death: Enter the permanent address. Specify if the death was Institutional (hospital) or Non-Institutional (home) and enter specific location details.
  9. Informant Details: Enter the name, address, and mobile number of the informant (usually the applicant).
  10. Statistical Information: Fill out details including religion, occupation of the deceased, and medical details (attending doctor, cause of death, etc.).
  11. Upload Document: Upload the JPG scan of the registrar's proof/letterpad (File size: 50 KB - 100 KB).
  12. Submission: Complete the captcha verification and click "इन्द्राज करे" (Submit/Save).
  13. Reference Number: Upon successful submission, write down the generated Reference Number carefully, along with the old registration number and year.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Offline Application (For Unregistered Deaths & Late Rules)

If the Death was NEVER Registered:

If the local registrar has no record of the death in their manual logs, you must first prepare a manual file to register it offline:

  1. Obtain a physical death registration form from the local registrar.
  2. Get signatures and Aadhaar ID proofs of two witnesses.
  3. The applicant must provide their Aadhaar card.
  4. Obtain an affidavit attested by a Notary or Tehsildar.
  5. Secure signatures and approvals from the local Sarpanch and Gram Sevak.
  6. Submit this file to the local registrar. Once they process it and generate a manual entry, you can proceed with the Legacy Computerization online.
Standard Offline Registration (Late Fees & Rules):

For standard offline registrations, visit the local municipal office, Nagar Palika, or Gram Panchayat. Collect the form, fill it out, and attach the deceased's ID, applicant's ID, and proof of death (hospital certificate or cremation receipt). The processing timelines and late permissions are as follows:

  • Within 21 Days: Free of cost.
  • 21 to 30 Days: Late fee applies; requires permission from the local Registrar.
  • 30 Days to 1 Year: Late fee applies; requires written permission from the designated authority (e.g., Block Development Officer).
  • After 1 Year: Registration can only be completed with an order from an Executive Magistrate (Tehsildar/SDM) after verifying the facts, submitting an affidavit, and paying the late fee.
afterApplying:
After Applying & Checking Application Status

To check the status of your legacy certificate computerization request, follow these steps:

  1. Go back to the Pehchan portal homepage and click on "आवेदन - लिगेसी प्रमाण पत्र कम्प्यूटरीकरण" again.
  2. At the top of the page, select the radio button for "आवेदन स्थिति" (Application Status).
  3. Enter your old Registration Number, Registration Year, and the newly generated Reference Number.
  4. Click on "आवेदन स्थिति देखे" (View Application Status) to check details.
  5. Once approved by the registrar, your digitized, digitally signed Death Certificate will be available to download from the portal.
